title: DCP Multi-Packet Product-Twirl SQ Dimension Audit
claims: Product-twirled cosine marginals are invariant under s -> -s mod q for any packet count T >= 1.
Over uniform headers a in Z_q^n, distinct unordered shift pairs {s, -s} have strictly orthogonal cosine profiles and single-packet chi-square divergence gamma^2 (if 2s=0) or gamma^2/2 (if 2s!=0).
Under chosen basis headers a = e_i, coordinate cosines are directly readable in O(n/gamma^2) samples.
